node.statement: Two-eta defect correction and conclusion: write R=T(AB)C and S=ABC, so F1=T(R)-T(S). Then T(F1)-F1=[T^2(R)-T(R)]-[T^2(S)-T(S)], whence ||T(F1)-F1||<=eta(||R||+||S||)<=2eta p because ||T(AB)||<=||A||||B|| and ||A||<=||X||, ||B||<=||Y||, ||C||<=||Z||. Since W=T(Q), contractivity and the five-eta bound give ||W-F1||<=||T(Q)-T(F1)||+||T(F1)-F1||<=5eta p+2eta p=7eta p. Finally ||F1||<=||W||+||W-F1||<=10eta p; substituting A=T(X), B=T(Y), C=T(Z) identifies F1 exactly with the Phi_assoc1 difference in node 1.2.
